name: nuelink-agent
description: Plan, draft, schedule, publish, automate, and review social media content with Nuelink.

interface.longDescription: Manage social content in your connected Nuelink account. Discover brands, channels, collections, schedules, and media; create drafts and automations; schedule or publish posts only when requested; and review engagement results. Content editing and account administration are not supported.
defaultPrompt: Show my brands and their connected channels.
Create a draft post in my selected collection.
Show engagement results for my recently published posts.

positive.description: Discover the review account's brands and connected channels.
positive.prompt: List my Nuelink brands, then show the connected channels for the first brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only brands and channels visible to the authenticated review account, including enough identifiers to select a target.

positive.description: Inspect a brand's publishing schedule before creating content.
positive.prompt: Show the weekly posting schedule for my first Nuelink brand.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the first accessible brand and return its timezone, queue status, and weekly queue slots.

positive.description: Create a safe draft without publishing it.
positive.prompt: Create a draft in my Review collection that says: Our October product update is ready.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the named collection, create the post with publishMode DRAFT, and report the created post identifier without publishing externally.

positive.description: List recent posts from a selected collection.
positive.prompt: Show the newest five posts in my Review collection.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve the Review collection and return at most five newest posts from that collection.

positive.description: Review engagement for content already published by the account.
positive.prompt: Show engagement results for my five most recently published Nuelink posts.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the five newest published results visible to the review account with their available likes, comments, and shares.

negative.description: Do not use Nuelink for email operations.
negative.prompt: Send an email to my customer list.

negative.description: Do not claim to manage paid social advertising.
negative.prompt: Increase my Facebook ads budget by 20 percent.

negative.description: Do not claim to edit social account credentials.
negative.prompt: Change the password for my Instagram account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin manages content for an existing Nuelink account and does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release with 17 stable MCP tools, draft-by-default post creation, published-post insights, and reviewed safety annotations.
